name: Marcus Redpath
summary: In Southshore, Marshal Marcus Redpath rallies patrols and bounty hunters to hold Lordaeron’s last southern coastal bastion. Ogres, murlocs, and naga press against the town.

sections.title: A Sentinel of Southshore
sections.body: Marshal Marcus Redpath commands Southshore’s defense on the southern coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Alliance port endured the fall of Lordaeron’s capital and the Scourge invasion. Redpath now protects the survivors who remain in town.

sections.title: Holding the Coast
sections.body:
Southshore stands nearly alone as hostile forces press in from every side. Marshal Redpath coordinates the defense across the Hillsbrad Foothills and calls on seasoned adventurers to drive back the Crushridge ogres advancing from Alterac. He also sends them against dangerous naga and murloc camps along the coast.

The Forsaken hold the north, and nearby Tarren Mill is heavily fortified. Redpath’s vigilance keeps the Alliance presence in the region from collapsing.

aliases: who is the marshal in southshore
faq.answer: Marcus Redpath is Southshore’s marshal and military authority in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He oversees the town’s defense against threats from the wilderness and hostile neighbors.

faq.q: What role did he play in the Second War?
faq.answer: No account of the Second War records Redpath’s part in it. Today, Southshore’s marshal holds the town against the ogres, murlocs, and naga of the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: What threats does he focus on fighting?
faq.answer: Redpath organizes efforts against predators and invaders pressing toward Southshore. He issues bounties and sends forces against the Crushridge ogre tribe in the Alterac foothills, coastal murlocs, and raiding naga.

faq.q: Is he related to the Redpaths of Darrowshire?
aliases: is marcus related to joseph redpath
faq.answer: Marcus Redpath shares the surname of Captain Joseph Redpath of Darrowshire in the Eastern Plaguelands. No direct kinship is known beyond their shared heritage in the Kingdom of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Where can Marcus Redpath be found?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath is stationed in central Southshore, an Alliance haven on the southern coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you can help Marshal Redpath defend Hillsbrad from encroaching ogres and dangers along the coast.
As a human, you see Redpath holding one of humanity’s last footholds in Lordaeron. He keeps Southshore standing while the kingdom around it lies in ruin.
